#### Clase `PSDraw` (Línea 31)
- **Docstring:** _Sets up printing to the given file. If ``fp`` is omitted,
``sys.stdout.buffer`` is assumed._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def __init__(self, fp)` (Línea 37): Sin docstring.
  - `def begin_document(self, id)` (Línea 42): Set up printing of a document. (Write PostScript DSC header.)
  - `def end_document(self)` (Línea 58): Ends printing. (Write PostScript DSC footer.)
  - `def setfont(self, font, size)` (Línea 64): Selects which font to use.

:param font: A PostScript font name
:param size: Size in points.
  - `def line(self, xy0, xy1)` (Línea 81): Draws a line between the two points. Coordinates are given in
PostScript point coordinates (72 points per inch, (0, 0) is the lower
left corner of the page).
  - `def rectangle(self, box)` (Línea 89): Draws a rectangle.

:param box: A tuple of four integers, specifying left, bottom, width and
   height.
  - `def text(self, xy, text)` (Línea 98): Draws text at the given position. You must use
:py:meth:`~PIL.PSDraw.PSDraw.setfont` before calling this method.
  - `def image(self, box, im, dpi)` (Línea 112): Draw a PIL image, centered in the given box.
